# Run onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws

Issue: re-cinq/HALEngine#94
Labels: priority:medium, type:bug, size:S, area:api

## Why

`beforeSession` is awaited before the `try` block opens, so a throw from it escapes before the `catch` and `finally` exist. Neither `onError` nor `afterSession` runs.

That breaks the guarantee the hook names imply. A deployer who allocates something in `beforeSession` — a span, a database handle, a rate-limit token — and releases it in `afterSession` leaks it on exactly the path where the allocation failed, and learns nothing from `onError` because it never fires. The failure is silent in the engine and visible only as an unexplained rejection at the caller.

Recorded as measured behaviour in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` by HALEngine#83, which scoped itself to specifying the seam rather than changing it, and raised again by the reviewer on that PR. The spec notes this property is owned by no issue in the epic; this is that issue.

## What to do

Move the `beforeSession` call inside the `try`, so a throw from it reaches the same `catch` and `finally` as any other failure in the turn, and decide one question explicitly: whether `afterSession` running after a failed `beforeSession` is what a deployer wants, or whether it needs to know the session never started. Record the answer in the spec either way, because a cleanup hook that cannot tell "never allocated" from "allocated and finished" is a new trap for the same reader.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A `beforeSession` that throws still reaches the caller as a rejection, unchanged from today
- [ ] `onError` fires for that throw, with the same argument shape as any other orchestrator failure
- [ ] `afterSession` fires for that throw, and the spec states what a hook can assume about how much of the turn happened
- [ ] A non-throwing `beforeSession` behaves exactly as today, pinned by the existing tests remaining unedited
- [ ] `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` replaces its recorded-flaw line with the new guarantee, and the CHANGELOG says what changes for an existing consumer
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run eslint` (`--max-warnings 0`) and `npm run prettier:check` pass

## Tech notes

Key files: `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` (the `beforeSession` call above the `try`), `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`.

Out of scope: the `instanceof Error` gate on `onError` (its own issue) and usage accounting across tool rounds (HALEngine#93).

# Lore test-command interface (lore_list_tests / lore_run_test).
# Written for this repo's Jest suite rather than adapted from the Vitest
# equivalent for a Vitest suite: the report shapes happen to match, but the
# invocations do not.
- id: hal-engine-jest
  name: HAL Engine Jest suite
  cwd: .
  description: >-
    The ts-jest unit suite over src/ and scripts/ (jest.config.js roots), run
    on every pull request in .github/workflows/ci.yml as the "Test" step.
    Selectors are "<repo-relative-file>::<full test name>" as emitted by the
    list command. Jest has no dry-run, so the list command executes the suite
    once with --json and derives every name from the report; it deliberately
    tolerates a red suite, since listing must not depend on the tests passing.
    The run command selects one test with --runTestsByPath plus an anchored,
    regex-escaped -t, and treats a selector that matches nothing as a failure
    rather than a green run of an empty suite. Neither command builds first:
    no test here reads dist/.
  list: node scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
  run: node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "{selector}"
  coverage_format: lcov

cd /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/237e10ee02ad/workspace/target; mkdir -p .lore; cat > .lore/dod.md <<'EOF'
# Definition of Done

> `beforeSession` is awaited before the `try` block opens, so a throw from it escapes before the `catch` and `finally` exist. Neither `onError` nor `afterSession` runs.

**Strategy: `direct`** — `createChatOrchestrator(...).processMessage` is the real entry point and takes hooks as plain options, so the test can call it today and fail on behaviour.

## Done when these pass

- [ ] **rejects to the caller with the original error and fires onError with (session, error)** — a throwing `beforeSession` still rejects with the same error, and `onError` fires once with `(session, error)`.
  `src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **still fires afterSession with the session** — `afterSession` fires once with the session after a throwing `beforeSession`.
  `src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts`

## Facets

- [ ] Move the `beforeSession` call inside the `try` in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`.
- [ ] Replace the recorded-flaw line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` with the new guarantee, stating what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened, and link it to these tests.
- [ ] Add a CHANGELOG entry for existing consumers.

## Out of scope

- The `instanceof Error` gate on `onError`.
- Usage accounting across tool rounds (HALEngine#93).
EOF
npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md >/dev/null
git add -A; git commit -qm "Add acceptance tests and DoD for beforeSession failure hooks (#94)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -q origin HEAD; git fetch -q origin main; git merge origin/main 2>&1|tail -2; git push -q origin HEAD; git status -sb|head -2

content.text:
I wrote two acceptance tests for #94. Both fail on the current code, and I've committed and pushed them. The branch is level with its upstream and `origin/main` merged cleanly.

The tests are in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts`. Both call `createChatOrchestrator(...).processMessage` with a `beforeSession` hook that throws:

- **`onError` test:** the call still rejects with the original error, and `onError` fires once with `(session, error)`.
- **`afterSession` test:** `afterSession` fires once with the session.

I ran only that file with `NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts`. Both tests fail because the hooks never run:

```
● a beforeSession hook that throws › rejects to the caller with the original error and fires onError with (session, error)
    - "onError": Array [ ["onError", [session, Error: allocation failed]] ]
    + "onError": Array [],
      "outcome": [Error: allocation failed],
● a beforeSession hook that throws › still fires afterSession with the session
    (expected one afterSession call with the session; received an empty array)
```

The `outcome` line shows the rejection already reaches the caller unchanged, so that part of the ticket holds today and the test passes on it. I wrote no test for the "non-throwing `beforeSession` behaves as today" criterion, because the existing tests already pin it.

I wrote `.lore/dod.md` with strategy `direct` and the ticket's central claim quoted. It also lists the facets for the implementing round: move the call inside the `try`, replace the recorded-flaw line in the spec with the new guarantee, and add a CHANGELOG entry.

There is no `scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs` in this repo, and `.lore/test-commands.yml` has no field for a spec anchor. I therefore put a spec reference in a comment at the top of the test file, and I added no `validated by` link to the spec. Linking the tests from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` is left to the implementing round.

LORE_NODE_RESULT: {"outcome":"success","extras":{"dod_strategy":"direct"}}
